notes.title: Bertram Fiddle returns in punny murder mystery A Bleaker Predicklement
notes.content:
The second episode of the punny Victorian London point-and-click game the Adventures of Bertram Fiddle [official site] is is out now, with plenty of riddles, tea-drinking and strangely-shaped noses. A Bleaker Predicklement follows on from the events of 2015’s A Dreadly Business and it’s “almost quadruple the size” of that outing, say developers Rumpus.

Mr Fiddle is a well-to-do adventurer with waistcoat and a bow tie who’s fallen on hard times. Funding for expeditions has dried up so he’s taken a job as a soap factory to make ends meet, but he soon gets caught up in a murder mystery and has to track down the killer. That involves trudging around the big smoke speaking to lots of suspicious folk, battling monsters and solving puzzles.

(more…)

notes.title: A Bleaker Predicklement is out now!
notes.content:
Yes. We know. We've promised it earlier. But finally it happened. A Bleaker Predicklement is finally out on Steam. And during its first week it will be 20% off.

And now, after delaying the game over and over again, it is finally out. And we'd love to say thanks. Thanks for your patience. Thanks for your trust. Thanks for being such a great community!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/489930/Adventures_of_Bertram_Fiddle_Episode_2/] A Bleaker Predicklement on Steam[/url]

- Rumpus Animation

notes.title: Episode 2 is underway! Huzzah!
notes.content:
After a long time working in Dulsworth's Soap Factory Bertram is finally ready to start adventuring again! 
We've been working on the story, new scenes and puzzles for a while now, trying to fit it all in in between other jobs. But we have managed to save up some funds (Lord Arthwipe still hasn't paid up, though) and are launching a Kickstarter soon so that we can go into full production.

http://giphy.com/gifs/robot-steampunk-victorian-xTiTnm6yeZdSIWNG7e

notes.title: Localised Version Now Available
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Adventurers!
We have updated the build so it now features Russian, Spanish and Japanese subtitles.
We are currently finishing off the German translation and that should be available soon.
You need to restart the game and Steam will automatically update the game.

Thank you!
